profile.description:
Profile is the shared configuration profile; the default chain's
when empty.

region.description: Region is the region; the profile's when empty.

AWS.description: AWS is how an AWS account is reached.

store.description: Store is the registry's store type, such as github-actions or aws-ssm.

account.description:
Account matches the registry store's account exactly, or as a
path.Match pattern such as "example-org/*"; "*" matches any account,
including an empty one.

Binding.description: Binding connects the stores of one type in matching accounts.

$schema.description: Schema is the JSON Schema's URL, for editors.

formatVersion.description: FormatVersion is the file format's version: "1".

bindings.description:
Bindings say how each store is reached. The first whose store type
and account match a registry store applies.

scan.description: Scan lists accounts to check beyond those the registry names.

tokenEnv.description:
TokenEnv is the environment variable holding the token. When empty,
GITHUB_TOKEN, then GH_TOKEN, then the GitHub CLI's (gh auth token).
The token is never written here.

baseUrl.description: BaseURL is the REST API's URL; https://api.github.com when empty.

GitHub.description: GitHub is how GitHub is reached.

githubRepositories.description:
GitHubRepositories are owner/repo names whose Actions secrets are
listed and whose workflows are read, so a secret a workflow reads and
the registry does not store is reported.

Scan.description: Scan lists accounts to check that the registry may not name.

title: credforge targets
description: How credforge reaches each store a credential registry names. It holds no secrets.
